run_oneshot_quantize: run oneshot to quantize a large language model with disk offloading using a calibration dataset
create_quantization_modifier: create a QuantizationModifier to configure NVFP4 weight quantization on Linear layers
build_load_offloaded_model: build a model loading pipeline using load_offloaded_model context manager for disk-offloaded inference
test_dispatch_model: test dispatch_model to move offloaded model layers to target devices for generation
review_get_device_map: review get_device_map to inspect which devices each model layer is assigned to
